chapter: New York with Lester Young and Coleman Hawkins
title: Sent to join Lester Young, who names him Sir Charles
summary: Thompson was sent for the Lester Young band in New York, where Lester, who loved him, gave him the name Sir Charles.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: But I was sent to come to play with Lester Young --
Did Lester send for you then?
-- Lester -- he -- they had told him -- I'm sure they had asked him probably some opinion about me. (I knew him. He must have knew about it.) Sure, of course. I met him in
Omaha, he knew what I did, and I'm sure that he wouldn't agree to have someone play who he didn't particularly like it.
And the fact of the matter is he's the one who named me Sir Charles, incidentally.

In fact I would have to say, with all sincerity, Lester Young loved me as a piano player, as a musician, as a guy. As I said because I met him earlier in Omaha, Nebraska when I first started, he knew me from the beginning and he knew my interest in music, and he knew I was really serious about music, and that I liked his music, and his style, and I liked him. And he was just beautiful.
He named Billie Lady Day and he named you Sir Charles.
